title: Wild Horse Nine (bc30)
synopsis: Shortly before the 1973 Chilean coup, CIA agents Chris and Lee are dispatched from Santiago to Easter Island by their bureau chief, MJ. Among the Island’s iconic statues, and as the longtime partners wrestle with their dark pasts and present conspiracies, Chris’s newfound bond with a pair of rebellious students threatens to send everyone’s trip to this remote paradise sideways. The latest work from Oscar-winning director Martin McDonagh is a poignant story of friendship, and the devastating gap between the ideal and reality, accompanied with his trademark incisive dialogue and dark humour. John Malkovich’s tour-de-force performance earned him the Volpi Cup for Best Actor at the Venice Film Festival.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 1973年智利政變前夕，年邁的CIA特工基斯與老友拍檔李被上司 MJ派往復活節島「放假」。在遍佈神秘巨石人像的島嶼上，基斯開始編寫自己的傳記，記下能說和不能說的秘密。原本看似悠閒的島嶼之旅，卻因兩名對政治充滿熱誠的叛逆女學生而逐漸失控……令這場「假期」變得荒謬、狂野又出人意表！《廣告牌殺人事件》金像導演馬田麥當奴最新力作，貫徹其精闢對白和黑色幽默，在理想與現實的衝突中回應時局。男主角尊麥高維治更憑精湛演出榮獲威尼斯影展最佳男主角獎。

cast: John Malkovich, Sam Rockwell, Steve Buscemi
